lines.text: 언덕 위에 다현이가 서 있어요. 하늘을 올려다보고 있어요.
lines.en: On a hill stands Dahyun, looking up at the sky.
segs: On a hill stands Dahyun, looking up at the sky.

lines.en: I want to meet a real unicorn.
segs: I want to meet a real unicorn.

lines.text: 유니콘에게 줄 빨간 꽃을 찾아 볼까요? 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Let's find a red flower for the unicorn. Tap it!
segs: Let's find a red flower for the unicorn. Tap it!

lines.text: 유니콘에게 줄 주황 꽃을 찾아 볼까요? 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Let's find an orange flower for the unicorn. Tap it!
segs: Let's find an orange flower for the unicorn. Tap it!

lines.text: 유니콘에게 줄 노란 꽃을 찾아 볼까요? 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Let's find a yellow flower for the unicorn. Tap it!
segs: Let's find a yellow flower for the unicorn. Tap it!

lines.text: 유니콘에게 줄 분홍 꽃을 찾아 볼까요? 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Let's find a pink flower for the unicorn. Tap it!
segs: Let's find a pink flower for the unicorn. Tap it!

lines.text: 유니콘에게 줄 보라 꽃을 찾아 볼까요? 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Let's find a purple flower for the unicorn. Tap it!
segs: Let's find a purple flower for the unicorn. Tap it!

lines.text: 유니콘에게 줄 파란 꽃을 찾아 볼까요? 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Let's find a blue flower for the unicorn. Tap it!
segs: Let's find a blue flower for the unicorn. Tap it!

lines.text: 유니콘에게 줄 하얀 꽃을 찾아 볼까요? 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Let's find a white flower for the unicorn. Tap it!
segs: Let's find a white flower for the unicorn. Tap it!

lines.en: That's right! A red flower.
That's right! An orange flower.
That's right! A yellow flower.
That's right! A pink flower.
That's right! A purple flower.
That's right! A blue flower.
That's right! A white flower.

lines.text: 다현이는 꽃을 똑 꺾어 바구니에 쏙 넣었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun picked the flower and popped it into her basket.
segs: Dahyun picked the flower and popped it into her basket.

lines.text: 다현이는 구름 나라로 올라가 보기로 했어요.
lines.en: Dahyun decided to climb up to the cloud country.
segs: Dahyun decided to climb up to the cloud country.

lines.text: 구름 섬에 양 한 마리가 혼자 앉아 있어요.
lines.en: On a cloud island, a little sheep sat all alone.
segs: On a cloud island, a little sheep sat all alone.

lines.en: Sniff... How do I get home...
segs: Sniff... How do I get home...

lines.text: 양이 앉은 구름을 톡, 눌러 봐요.
lines.en: Tap the cloud the sheep is sitting on.
segs: Tap the cloud the sheep is sitting on.

lines.en: The sheep hopped right down!
Let's go together!

lines.text: 다현이와 양은 손을 잡고 구름 길을 걸었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun and the sheep walked the cloud path hand in hand.
segs: Dahyun and the sheep walked the cloud path hand in hand.

lines.en: Thank you! I can see my home now!
segs: Thank you! I can see my home now!

lines.text: 양은 집으로 돌아갔어요. 유니콘은 아직 보이지 않아요.
lines.en: The sheep went home. The unicorn was still nowhere to be seen.
segs: The sheep went home. The unicorn was still nowhere to be seen.

lines.text: 밤이 되자, 다현이는 별빛 숲으로 들어갔어요.
lines.en: When night came, Dahyun walked into the starlight forest.
segs: When night came, Dahyun walked into the starlight forest.

lines.en: Ouch, ouch...

lines.text: 사슴 다리에 가시가 박혔어요. 가시를 톡, 눌러 봐요. 살살 빼 줄게요.
lines.en: There are thorns in the deer's leg. Tap a thorn, and we will pull them out gently.
segs: There are thorns in the deer's leg. Tap a thorn, and we will pull them out gently.

lines.en: All three thorns are out!
Thank you! It doesn't hurt at all now.
segs: Thank you! It doesn't hurt at all now.

lines.text: 다현이는 사슴의 작은 뿔을 가만히 보았어요.
lines.en: Dahyun looked quietly at the deer's little antlers.
segs: Dahyun looked quietly at the deer's little antlers.

lines.en: You're... not a unicorn.

lines.text: 폭포 위에 무지개가 떠 있어요. 말 한 마리가 서 있어요.
lines.en: A rainbow hangs over the waterfall. A horse is standing there.
segs: A rainbow hangs over the waterfall. A horse is standing there.

lines.en: Grrrumble...

lines.text: 말은 다현이의 간식 바구니를 보고 있어요.
lines.en: The horse was looking at Dahyun's snack basket.
segs: The horse was looking at Dahyun's snack basket.

lines.en: Here, let's share.
The horse munched the snack happily.
segs: The horse munched the snack happily.

lines.en: Thank you! That was delicious.
You're not... a unicorn either.
The sun went down, and the road was empty.
segs: The sun went down, and the road was empty.

lines.en: Maybe... there is no real unicorn.
segs: Maybe... there is no real unicorn.

lines.en: Dahyun trudged along, looking only at the ground.
segs: Dahyun trudged along, looking only at the ground.

lines.en: Just then, a small sound came from behind.
segs: Just then, a small sound came from behind.

lines.en: Dahyun slowly turned around.

lines.text: 달빛 아래, 하얀 유니콘이 서 있었어요.
lines.en: There in the moonlight stood a white unicorn.
segs: There in the moonlight stood a white unicorn.

lines.en: I was here all along.

lines.text: 네가 친절한 걸 다 보고 있었어.
lines.en: I saw how kind you were, every time.
segs: I saw how kind you were, every time.

lines.en: A unicorn...!
Tap the unicorn to say hello.
segs: Tap the unicorn to say hello.

lines.en: Dahyun hugged the unicorn tight.

lines.text: 다현이는 유니콘과 함께 집 앞 언덕으로 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: Dahyun came back to the hill by her home with the unicorn.
segs: Dahyun came back to the hill by her home with the unicorn.

lines.text: 다현이는 아침에 꺾은 빨간 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun tucked the red flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun tucked the red flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.

lines.text: 다현이는 아침에 꺾은 주황 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun tucked the orange flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun tucked the orange flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.

lines.text: 다현이는 아침에 꺾은 노란 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun tucked the yellow flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun tucked the yellow flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.

lines.text: 다현이는 아침에 꺾은 분홍 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun tucked the pink flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun tucked the pink flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.

lines.text: 다현이는 아침에 꺾은 보라 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun tucked the purple flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun tucked the purple flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.

lines.text: 다현이는 아침에 꺾은 파란 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun tucked the blue flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun tucked the blue flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.

lines.text: 다현이는 아침에 꺾은 하얀 꽃을 유니콘 갈기에 꽂아 주었어요.
lines.en: Dahyun tucked the white flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.
segs: Dahyun tucked the white flower she picked this morning into the unicorn's mane.

lines.en: Thank you. It's so pretty!

If you are kind to someone, you can meet a unicorn of your very own.
ui.너도 누군가에게 친절하면, 너만의 유니콘을 만날 수 있어: If you are kind to someone, you can meet a unicorn of your very own
